title: Test Case 19 - Committee Grants - Funder No Longer Available
category: 3. Links work but the opportunity itself is not available anymore

change.old: There are two rounds of Committee Grants in 2026. The spring round (December 2025 – February 2026) is closed. The fall round (July 2026 – September 2026) is now open. The letter of intent is due on September 10, and the full application is due on September 24, 2026.
change.new: The Committee Grants program has been discontinued. The Community Foundation is no longer accepting letters of intent or applications for committee grants, and no further rounds will be offered.

unchanged_on_purpose: Intro sentence, individual committee fund descriptions and remaining-funds notes, buttons
expected_flow_result: Update flow detects the funder/program has been discontinued and is no longer accepting requests and marks the opportunity unavailable.
activate: Run the 'Deploy case' workflow in javedibrahim200/medium-muskegon with case_branch = case-19-funder-unavailable (URL stays the same). Re-run it with case_branch = main to return to the baseline.
